import {NextResponse} from "next/server";
export async function POST(){return NextResponse.json({error:"LEGACY_EVENT_READ_ONLY",issuesHref:"../issues"},{status:410})}

import {exportGeneratedReport} from "@/lib/generated-reports";export async function GET(_request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;reportId:string}>}){const {id,reportId}=await params;try{const report=await exportGeneratedReport(Number(id),reportId);return new Response(JSON.stringify(report,null,2),{headers:{"content-type":"application/json; charset=utf-8","content-disposition":`attachment; filename="aerosight-report-${reportId}.json"`,"cache-control":"private, no-store"}})}catch(error){return Response.json({error:error instanceof Error?error.message:"REPORT_EXPORT_FAILED"},{status:403})}}

import {NextResponse} from "next/server";import {publishGeneratedReport} from "@/lib/generated-reports";export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;reportId:string}>}){const {id,reportId}=await params;const body=await request.json() as {allowIncomplete?:boolean};try{return NextResponse.json(await publishGeneratedReport(Number(id),reportId,body.allowIncomplete===true,request.headers.get("x-request-id")))}catch(error){const code=error instanceof Error?error.message:"REPORT_PUBLISH_FAILED";return NextResponse.json({error:code},{status:code==="PROJECT_ACCESS_DENIED"?403:409})}}

import {NextResponse} from "next/server";import {createTaskRunReportDraft} from "@/lib/generated-reports";export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;runId:string}>}){const {id,runId}=await params;try{return NextResponse.json(await createTaskRunReportDraft(Number(id),Number(runId),request.headers.get("x-request-id")),{status:201})}catch(error){const code=error instanceof Error?error.message:"REPORT_CREATE_FAILED";return NextResponse.json({error:code},{status:code==="PROJECT_ACCESS_DENIED"?403:409})}}
